title: EO 90-Day Milestone Passes: Tranche 2 Two Days Away as NSA UMBRA Records Draw Global Attention
detail: May 20, 2026 marks approximately 90 days since President Trump's February 19 Truth Social announcement directing the Pentagon to begin releasing UAP and alien-related files to the public. The milestone passes without a formal ceremony — the PURSUE Tranche 2 release is now two days away (scheduled May 22). Newsweek and multiple international outlets published detailed reporting on the NSA's May 18 Top Secret UMBRA document release, highlighting the most striking contents: a heavily redacted multi-witness account of 13 fighter jets scrambled to intercept an object described as 'impossible to be an aircraft,' exhibiting rapid vertical motion at high altitude with white luminous light and a slightly bluish hue. A separate UMBRA document describes a 'star-shaped entity.' The NSA UMBRA release represents a parallel declassification track outside the PURSUE program — demonstrating that the UAP file landscape extends well beyond DoD channels. With Tranche 2 confirmed imminent and Pentagon spokesperson Parnell's public commitment to continued rolling releases, the PURSUE program has now produced its first sustained institutional disclosure cadence since the phenomenon became a matter of congressional concern in the late 2010s. The 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline under Trump's executive order falls in late November/December 2026.
confidenceReason: Milestone date confirmed by executive order timeline (Feb 19 + 90 days = May 20). Newsweek NSA UMBRA coverage confirmed. Rolling release cadence confirmed by Pentagon spokesperson statements via Fox News (May 19).
